title: ExecutionStatus
description: Point-in-time reconciliation view of one submitted ExecutionIntent. It wraps the durable ExecutionReceipt (the submit acknowledgement) and, once the run is terminal, the correlated ExecutionResult. It is a read model, not a durable record: Dagster remains the record of execution state, and an ExecutionReceipt remains the acknowledgement of submission.

cancellation.description: The outcome of a cancel request. `requested` records that cancellation was asked for; `accepted` records whether Dagster's coordinator accepted it; `status` is the run status observed immediately afterwards. A request that is accepted may still be in progress (status CANCELING) and reconcile later to a terminal CANCELED state.
